'''Clue scroll (medium)''' is a [[cipher clue]] obtained during [[Treasure Trails]]. It requires you speak to [[Captain Harlan]] in [[Lumbridge]].

==Clue info==
{{Clue info
|id = 929
|text = The cipher reveals who to speak to:<br><br>BZOSZHM GZQKZM
|notes = Speak to the [[Captain Harlan]] outside of [[Lumbridge Castle]].
The clue requires completion of a [[challenge scroll]]:

Question: ''How many snakeskins are needed in order to craft 44 boots, 29 vambraces and 34 bandanas?''

Answer: '''666'''
|map = {{Map|name=Captain Harlan|x=3218|y=3238|r=4|mtype=square|bucket=yes}}
}}
